The Defective Detective — Album 2: Serah Investigates

Nyan-Cast

"This is Foxxie Welcome to Nyan-Cast"

[Verse] White corridor Soft white light Two guards walking left and right

Foxxie keeps her eyes ahead Correction transfer Building Red

No phone No feed No final word No one coming No one heard

Mom and Dad had tried their best Then watched the Company threaten the rest

[Pre-Chorus] She’d seen the ones who came back changed Same eyes Same face Something rearranged

Living

Breathing

Smiling when told

But whatever made them them

Was gone

[Chorus] This is Foxxie Welcome to Nyan-Cast Maybe this is the final broadcast

If I disappear If I lose my name Someone else remember why we came

This is Foxxie Welcome to Nyan-Cast I said what I could Maybe that will last

If revolution starts with one small sound

Then somebody Please

Keep passing it around

[Verse] Van door shuts Metal floor Foxxie watches through the door

City passing Window grey Correction getting close today

She thinks of every voice she aired Every Kin nobody else had cared

Every story hidden clean Every truth cut from the evening feed

She smiles

Small

Almost tired

“At least I tried.”

[Pre-Chorus] No miracle No rescue plan No secret friend No helping hand

Just one last hope

That somewhere outside

Someone heard

And stayed alive

[Chorus] This is Foxxie Welcome to Nyan-Cast Maybe this is the final broadcast

If I disappear If I lose my name Someone else remember why we came

This is Foxxie Welcome to Nyan-Cast I said what I could Maybe that will last

If revolution starts with one small sound

Then somebody Please

Keep passing it around

[Bridge] Meanwhile

Coda’s map across the dash Transfer route Security pass

Kamira spreads the photos wide “These are the guards assigned inside.”

Nessa scans the badges twice Tiny printer Blue-white light

Copies logos Copies names Copies every little Company frame

Serah checks the time

“Window?”

Coda says, “Four minutes.”

Andy sits behind them

Quiet

Then says,

“We help Foxxie first.”

Serah turns

Andy shrugs

“Nessa’s helping me.”

“And I know what it’s like…”

“When nobody comes.”

[Pre-Chorus] Serah nods

No speech

No grand reply

Just starts the engine

“Alright.”

[Chorus] Nyan-Cast Still alive Five against a Company drive

Camera ready Codes in place Borrowed badges Straightest face

Nyan-Cast One little sound Turns into Kin coming back around

The system thought the message passed

But somebody heard

Nyan-Cast

[Verse] Checkpoint light Van rolls slow

Company transport waiting below

Serah steps out Badge displayed

“Transfer reassigned.”

Guard looks down

Kamira stands with clipboard face Coda acts bored Perfect pace

Nessa scans Green light

Andy stays low Out of sight

One guard frowns

“This wasn’t scheduled.”

Serah doesn’t blink

“Update came through seven minutes ago.”

Coda coughs

“Six.”

“I mean Six.” Serah says -

Gate unlocks

[Pre-Chorus] Door slides open

Foxxie looks up

Confused

Tired

Done

Then sees pink hair

And the whole world stops

[Break] Nessa smiles

Not big

Not dramatic

Just enough

“I was your first subscriber, you know.”

Foxxie stares

“Nessa?”

“No…”

Nessa reaches out

“Yeah.”

Foxxie takes her hand

[Chorus] This is Foxxie Welcome to Nyan-Cast Turns out maybe that wasn’t the last

One voice vanished One came through One old dream remembered who

This is Foxxie Welcome to Nyan-Cast Some things disappear Some things come back

If revolution starts with one small sound

Then maybe somebody

Was listening all along

[Final Chorus] Nyan-Cast Get inside Serah hits the gas and drives

Coda laughing Kamira yelling Nessa holding Foxxie tight

Andy grinning Foxxie crying City lights begin to slide

No correction No erased mind

Not tonight

Nyan-Cast Signal found One more voice they couldn’t drown

No grand victory Not the end

Just one more Kin

Coming back again

[Outro] Sirens wake behind the road

Coda says “They noticed.”

Serah answers “Obviously.”

Kamira looks behind them

Then forward

Then at everyone crammed inside

She starts smiling

Serah notices

“What?”

Kamira says,

“I know the perfect place where we can stay.”

“Should I be worried?” Serah asked

Kamira then replies “Probably.”

“Fox it! Let’s go!”
